segments.en: NETWORKING DEVICES
segments.zh: 網路裝置

blocks.en:
What is a network? 
A computer network is a digital telecommunications network allows NODES to share RESOURCES. 
A CLIENT is a device that accesses a service made available by a SERVER. 
A SERVER is a device that provides functions or services for CLIENTS.

segments.en: What is a network?
segments.zh: 什麼是網路？

segments.en: A computer network is a digital telecommunications network allows NODES to share RESOURCES.
segments.zh: 電腦網路是一種數位電信網路，讓節點（nodes）可以共享資源（resources）。

segments.en: A CLIENT is a device that accesses a service made available by a SERVER.
segments.zh: 用戶端（client）是存取伺服器所提供服務的裝置。

segments.en: A SERVER is a device that provides functions or services for CLIENTS.
segments.zh: 伺服器（server）是為用戶端提供功能或服務的裝置。

blocks.zh:
什麼是網路？
電腦網路是一種數位電信網路，讓節點（nodes）可以共享資源（resources）。
用戶端（client）是存取伺服器所提供服務的裝置。
伺服器（server）是為用戶端提供功能或服務的裝置。

blocks.en:
• 
Note : The same device can be a CLIENT in some situations and a SERVER in other situations. 
Ex: A Peer-to-Peer network. 
SWITCHES (Level 2):

segments.en: Note : The same device can be a CLIENT in some situations and a SERVER in other situations.
segments.zh: 注意：同一部裝置在某些情況下可以是用戶端，在其他情況下則可以是伺服器。

segments.en: Ex: A Peer-to-Peer network.
segments.zh: 例如：對等式（Peer-to-Peer）網路。

segments.en: SWITCHES (Level 2):
segments.zh: 交換器（第 2 層）：

blocks.zh:
•
注意：同一部裝置在某些情況下可以是用戶端，在其他情況下則可以是伺服器。
例如：對等式（Peer-to-Peer）網路。
交換器（第 2 層）：

blocks.en:
• 
provide connectivity to hosts within the same LAN (Local Area Network) 
• 
Have many network interfaces/ports for End Hosts to connect to. 
• 
DO NOT provide connectivity between LANs/over the Internet. 
ROUTERS (Level 3):

segments.en: provide connectivity to hosts within the same LAN (Local Area Network)
segments.zh: 為同一個區域網路（LAN，Local Area Network）內的主機提供連線。

segments.en: Have many network interfaces/ports for End Hosts to connect to.
segments.zh: 具有多個網路介面／連接埠，供終端主機連接。

segments.en: DO NOT provide connectivity between LANs/over the Internet.
segments.zh: 不負責不同 LAN 之間或通往網際網路的連線。

segments.en: ROUTERS (Level 3):
segments.zh: 路由器（第 3 層）：

blocks.zh:
•
為同一個區域網路（LAN，Local Area Network）內的主機提供連線。
•
具有多個網路介面／連接埠，供終端主機連接。
•
不負責不同 LAN 之間或通往網際網路的連線。
路由器（第 3 層）：

blocks.en:
• 
have fewer network interfaces than switches. 
• 
are used to provide connectivity BETWEEN LANs. 
• 
are used to send data over the Internet. 
FIREWALL (Can be Level 3,4, and 7):

segments.en: have fewer network interfaces than switches.
segments.zh: 網路介面通常比交換器少。

segments.en: are used to provide connectivity BETWEEN LANs.
segments.zh: 用於連接不同的區域網路。

segments.en: are used to send data over the Internet.
segments.zh: 用於透過網際網路傳送資料。

segments.en: FIREWALL (Can be Level 3,4, and 7):
segments.zh: 防火牆（可運作於第 3、4 與 7 層）：

blocks.zh:
•
網路介面通常比交換器少。
•
用於連接不同的區域網路。
•
用於透過網際網路傳送資料。
防火牆（可運作於第 3、4 與 7 層）：

blocks.en:
• 
Firewalls are specialty hardware network security devices that control network traffic 
entering/exiting your network. 
• 
Can be places "inside" or "outside" the network. 
• 
Monitor and control network traffic based on configured rules. 
• 
Are known as "Next-Generation Firewalls" when they include more modern and advanced filtering 
capabilities. 
• 
Host-based firewalls are software applications that filter traffic entering and exiting a host 
machine, like a PC.

segments.en: Firewalls are specialty hardware network security devices that control network traffic entering/exiting your network.
segments.zh: 防火牆是專用的硬體網路安全設備，用來控制進出網路的流量。

segments.en: Can be places "inside" or "outside" the network.
segments.zh: 可以放置在網路的「內部」或「外部」。

segments.en: Monitor and control network traffic based on configured rules.
segments.zh: 依據設定的規則監控與管制網路流量。

segments.en: Are known as "Next-Generation Firewalls" when they include more modern and advanced filtering capabilities.
segments.zh: 如果具備較新且進階的過濾功能，便稱為「次世代防火牆」（Next-Generation Firewalls）。

segments.en: Host-based firewalls are software applications that filter traffic entering and exiting a host machine, like a PC.
segments.zh: 主機型防火牆是軟體應用程式，用來過濾進出某部主機（例如 PC）的流量。

blocks.zh:
•
防火牆是專用的硬體網路安全設備，用來控制進出網路的流量。
•
可以放置在網路的「內部」或「外部」。
•
依據設定的規則監控與管制網路流量。
•
如果具備較新且進階的過濾功能，便稱為「次世代防火牆」（Next-Generation Firewalls）。
•
主機型防火牆是軟體應用程式，用來過濾進出某部主機（例如 PC）的流量。
